features.title: Intelligent Gantt Scheduling
features.body: Coordinate short-cycle, execution-heavy activities with frequent progress updates from site teams. Replace static timelines with live schedules that reflect actual on-ground progress.

features.title: Real-Time Critical Path Tracking
features.body: Detect delays automatically. When a delay develops on a critical path activity, the downstream impact on successor activities is calculated and shown immediately.
bullets: Early warning alerts for milestone misses

faqs.q: How does SiteFlow handle real-time schedule updates?
faqs.a: Site teams push progress from the field and the Gantt recalculates dependencies and float so the plan always reflects actuals.

faqs.q: Can I import existing schedules from other software?
faqs.a: Yes, discuss import from tools such as MS Project during onboarding so your baseline plan carries over.

faqs.q: What happens when a critical path activity is delayed?
faqs.a: The downstream impact on successor activities is calculated and shown immediately, with early warnings for milestone misses.
